subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should plugin Control UI entry points be an in-app opaque-sandbox-only contract for this PR, or may plugins declare top-level same-window/new-window entry points on the Control UI origin?
rationale: This is a new public plugin SDK and Gateway protocol surface that crosses browser isolation, operator auth, and plugin trust boundaries; automation can identify the risk but cannot choose the permanent trust model for maintainers.

options.title: Sandbox-only entry points
options.body: Remove same-window/new-window from this PR, use a fixed opaque iframe sandbox, and treat external plugin UI as a future separate-origin design.

options.title: Approve external modes explicitly
options.body: Keep external modes only with maintainer-approved security design, docs, tests, and proof explaining why top-level plugin UI on the Control UI origin is acceptable.

options.title: Pause behind the RFC
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC until the plugin UI trust model is decided.

recommendation.title: Sandbox-only entry points
recommendation.body: Remove same-window/new-window from this PR, use a fixed opaque iframe sandbox, and treat external plugin UI as a future separate-origin design.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman validated and merged the foundation host-hook surface and is the strongest visible reviewer/merger signal for this plugin UI trust-boundary decision.
